title: Le Bronze et la Cendre — Qloo Taste-Matched Trailer (Yann Abadie)

films_and_visual_aesthetic.name: Dune: Part Two (Denis Villeneuve, 2024)
films_and_visual_aesthetic.rationale: Readers combining literary antiquity with hard SF over-index 5.2x on Villeneuve's monolithic brutalist framing and bronze/ochre dust palettes.

films_and_visual_aesthetic.name: Blade Runner 2049 (Denis Villeneuve, 2017)
films_and_visual_aesthetic.rationale: High affinity on tactile relic examination scenes, museum-like silence, and amber-lit shadow geometry.

films_and_visual_aesthetic.name: Rome (HBO Series, Bruno Heller)
films_and_visual_aesthetic.rationale: Strong overlap on oil-lamp antiquity textures, military insignia, and political stoicism.

soundtrack_and_composers.name: Jóhann Jóhannsson
soundtrack_and_composers.rationale: Brass-and-organ slow-burn motifs bridging ancient liturgy and futuristic minimalism.

soundtrack_and_composers.name: Max Richter
soundtrack_and_composers.rationale: Elegiac strings ('On the Nature of Daylight' cohort) matching the philosophical weight of Memoirs of Hadrian readers.

soundtrack_and_composers.name: Wardruna / Einar Selvik
soundtrack_and_composers.rationale: Bronze horn and ritual percussion textures over-indexed by historical-mythological SF readers.

audience_personas.segment: Literary & Philosophical Sci-Fi Readers (Hyperion / Dune / Yourcenar crossover)

shots.prompt: Macro cinematic shot of an ancient verdigris bronze Roman oil lamp resting on dark volcanic ash; a warm flame flickers as fine ash particles drift upward in slow motion.
shots.voiceover_fr: En 2287, on croyait les empires éteints. Il ne restait que le bronze… et la cendre.
shots.voiceover_en: In 2287, they believed empires were extinct. Only bronze remained... and ash.
shots.qloo_anchor: Blade Runner 2049 relic lighting × Rome oil-lamp texture

shots.prompt: Close-up of gloved archivist hands brushing grey ash off a fractured bronze military medallion bearing an imperial eagle and Latin-futuristic coordinates.
shots.voiceover_fr: Sous la poussière des archives orbitales, un serment vieux de deux millénaires refait surface.
shots.voiceover_en: Beneath the dust of orbital archives, a two-thousand-year-old oath resurfaces.

shots.prompt: Wide low-angle shot inside a monumental brutalist vault in 2287 where shafts of amber light cut through cold slate shadow onto a solitary silhouette examining a holographic stele.
shots.voiceover_fr: Car les machines changent de siècle, mais la mécanique du pouvoir garde le même visage.
shots.voiceover_en: For machines change centuries, yet the machinery of power keeps the very same face.
shots.qloo_anchor: Dune: Part Two monolithic architectural scale

shots.prompt: Medium shot of a commander in weathered bronze-and-carbon armor standing at the threshold of a wind-swept stone terrace at dusk, embers drifting past his motionless profile.
shots.voiceover_fr: Quand la Légion d'Airain réclame son dû, nul ne choisit impunément son camp.
shots.voiceover_en: When the Brazen Legion claims its debt, no one chooses a side with impunity.
shots.qloo_anchor: Memoirs of Hadrian stoic portrait × Villeneuve palette

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up on the protagonist's eyes reflecting a warm amber flame in the darkness, slow push-in as the flame steadies.
shots.voiceover_fr: Que reste-t-il d'un homme lorsque l'Histoire efface jusqu'à son nom ?
shots.voiceover_en: What remains of a man when History erases even his name?

shots.prompt: Exact typographic end-card on #0C0F1A midnight background with #D8B982 antique gold serif typography: YANN ABADIE — LE BRONZE ET LA CENDRE.
shots.voiceover_fr: Le Bronze et la Cendre. Un roman de Yann Abadie.
shots.voiceover_en: Bronze and Ash. A novel by Yann Abadie.
